svg.title: Dakshin Raj — tech stack
svg.desc: My stack drawn as a system map: client, API, agent core and data layers on a language runtime inside cloud infrastructure. Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, C, Dart; Mobile: Flutter; Backend: FastAPI, Node.js, Express, Django, REST APIs; Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Cloudflare D1, Redis, Firebase; Agentic AI: LangGraph, LangChain, MCP, FastMCP, Tool calling, Multi-agent orchestration; LLMs: Groq, Llama, GPT-OSS, Ollama, Qwen, Gemini API; RAG & Doc AI: RAG pipelines, PaddleOCR, PyMuPDF, PDF extraction; Integrations: Google Sheets, OAuth 2.0, WebSockets, MQTT; Cloud & Tooling: GCP, Cloudflare, Vercel, Render, Git, GitHub.
